title: RRWNet: Recursive Refinement Network for effective retinal artery/vein segmentation and classification
mechanism: A base subnetwork plus a recursive refinement subnetwork that iteratively corrects manifest class confusions in multi-class thin-structure maps; the refinement module also works as a post-processor for other models.
adaptation: Run the recursive module on the 24-class probabilities to fix crack vs inactive (20% of train crack pixels sit in or at inactive) and crack vs gridline / ribbon confusions; train on out-of-fold maps from the 5 fold models.
min_experiment: Arm: house + recursive refinement module. Baseline: house / PF. Metrics: crack-inactive-gridline confusion, inactive IoU, gridline IoU, mIoU_rob, crack IoU on 5-fold CV and clean-49. Kill: mIoU_rob < +0.005 and inactive IoU < +0.01.
evidence: R: state of the art A/V segmentation on three public fundus datasets with fewer manifest classification errors; module improves other methods' maps as post-processing (numbers not read).
